title: Contributor Supplykit and Benefits Onramp
author: Aisha Patel
body:
Overview:
A checklist-style playbook for new contributors (ICs and first-line managers) joining Redwood. It combines the people-ops "supplykit" (access, benefits activation, core tooling) with a short orientation to role expectations and the career ladder, so new hires can reach impact within their first 90 days.

Who this is for:
- New individual contributors (engineering, product, design, data).
- Managers onboarding new direct reports.
- People-ops and Hiring Managers coordinating activation and benefits enrollment.

Owners and contact points:
- Primary owner: People Operations (Aisha Patel, people-ops@redwood.com)
- Manager onboarding liaison: Marcus Lee (manager-enablement@redwood.com)
- IT & Access owner: Platform Onboarding (it-onboard@redwood.com)

Objectives:
1) Every new hire has the tools they need on day 1 (or within 48 hours).
2) Benefits enrollment and payroll/compensation activation are simple and auditable.
3) Clear role expectations and career ladder touchpoints support early success.
4) A standard first-90 workflow reduces cross-team friction.

Quickstart: Day 0 -> 30 -> 60 -> 90 checklist:
- Day 0 (pre-boarding):
  1. Offer accepted -> People-ops sends the Welcome Packet with forms and the first-week agenda.
  2. Hiring manager opens the IT ticket (template: /ops/it-onboarding-template) covering hardware plus Slack/email provisioning.
  3. Buddy assigned and orientation invites sent.
- Day 1–7 (activation):
  1. Confirm SSO and company email.
  2. Register in the benefits portal (steps below).
  3. Join #org-all, #team-<teamname>, #onboarding.
  4. Meet your manager on expectations, read the role brief, clear any access blockers.
- Day 30:
  1. Share 1–2 small deliverables or learning outcomes.
  2. Manager checkpoint on role expectations and the first-90 plan.
  3. Confirm access to CI/CD, staging clusters, and internal repos.
- Day 60:
  1. Lead a small, clearly owned piece of work.
  2. Career ladder baseline agreed between manager and contributor.
- Day 90:
  1. Formal 90-day review: people-ops gathers feedback; manager records outcomes and next objectives.
  2. Benefit elections finalized and office/hardware stipends reimbursed.

Benefits activation:
1. Health & dental: use the Benefits Portal link in the Welcome Packet (create account -> verify identity -> select plan -> confirm dependents). Enrollment window: new hires have 31 days from start date to elect coverage.
2. Retirement plan (401k): opt in via the payroll portal; matching and vesting details are in the Benefits Portal.
3. Commuter and wellness stipends: submit via expenses.redwood.com tagged "onboarding-stipend" within 90 days.
4. Equity grants & RSU paperwork: HR sends the grant notice within 14 business days of start; sign and return to equity@redwood.com.
5. Relocation (if applicable): send receipts and the signed relocation addendum to finance@redwood.com.

Internal tools access matrix:
| Area | Minimum access day | Typical owner | How to escalate |
| --- | ---: | --- | --- |
| Email & SSO | Day 0 | IT Onboarding | it-onboard@redwood.com |
| Slack | Day 0 | IT / People-ops | it-onboard@redwood.com |
| Code repos (git, monorepo) | Day 2 | Team Eng Leads | repo-admin@redwood.com |
| CI/CD pipelines | Day 5 | Team Infra | infra-eng@redwood.com |
| Staging/Dev cluster | Day 10 | Platform SRE | platform-oncall@redwood.com |
| HR/Payroll portals | Day 1 | People-ops | people-ops@redwood.com |
| Benefits portal | Day 1 | People-ops | benefits@redwood.com |
| Expense & reimbursements | Day 3 | Finance | finance@redwood.com |
| Internal wiki / Confluence | Day 0 | People-ops | confluence-admin@redwood.com |

Access requests:
- Standard: manager files the "New Hire Access" ticket in ServiceDesk; privileged access needs manager + security approval.
- Expedited: tag "expedite" and cc people-ops; IT triages business-critical needs with a 24h target.

Role expectations & career ladder primer (IC focus):
- Redwood separates impact scope from management. IC ladder: Associate IC -> IC -> Senior IC -> Staff -> Principal, defined by scope (feature -> subsystem -> cross-product), autonomy, and influence.
- During ramp, managers write a role brief in week one, co-author a 90-day success plan, and hold weekly 1:1s for the first 60 days.
- Checkpoints:
  1. Baseline level and growth focus set within 30 days.
  2. Three measurable milestones tied to ladder descriptors.
  3. 90-day evaluation against the competency rubric (linked in the Welcome Packet).

Manager checklist:
1. Complete the IT Access template within 48 hours of offer acceptance.
2. Weekly checkpoints for the first 8 weeks.
3. Assign a buddy and make cross-functional introductions.
4. Share a role brief and the first three prioritized objectives.
5. Confirm benefits registration and stipend processing by day 30.

Tooling tips:
- Monorepo bootstrap:
  git clone git@github.com:redwood/monorepo.git && cd monorepo && ./scripts/bootstrap.sh
- Local dev (containerized, see /docs/dev-setup.md):
  ./tools/dev up --profile minimal

Learning resources:
- Engineering: "Redwood Runtime 101" and perf lab tutorials.
- Product: product-principles.pdf and the market-readouts repository.
- Cross-functional: "Working with GTM" checklist.
- Leadership: Manager Coaching modules in the people-ops learning portal.

Audit and compliance:
- People-ops keeps onboarding artifacts for 7 years per retention policy; access grants are logged in the IAM audit system.
- Managers confirm access revocation via the Offboarding Playbook checklist.

Feedback loop:
- If a step exceeded its expected SLA (SSO 24h, code repo 48h, cluster access 10 days), file an "onboarding-retro" ticket in the People-ops project.
- Each quarter people-ops samples 10% of recent hires for a retro call.

Appendix A — Templates and links:

Appendix B — Escalation matrix:
1. People-ops (people-ops@redwood.com) — first contact.
2. IT Onboarding (it-onboard@redwood.com) — access and hardware.
3. Security (sec-ops@redwood.com) — privileged access or audit questions.
4. VP People (vp-people@redwood.com) — SLA breaches unresolved after 72 hours.

Maintenance:
- Reviewed annually and after major benefits or tooling changes.
